literal: In those ways perfection attained even if, benefit is without indeed, king excellence without country.
translation: Even if a country has achieved all the aforementioned perfections, they are of no use if it lacks an excellent ruler.
modern: மேற்கூறிய எல்லா சிறப்புகளையும் பெற்றிருந்தாலும், சிறந்த அரசன் இல்லாத நாட்டுக்கு அவற்றால் எந்தப் பயனும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet concludes the chapter on the features of a good country by emphasizing the paramount importance of leadership. The phrase 'ஆங்கு அமைவு' refers to all the previously mentioned perfections, such as wealth, health, and resources. However, 'பயம் இன்றே' declares that these are completely useless without 'வேந்து அமைவு', which is the excellence of the ruler. The word 'அமைவு' is used twice, contrasting the material perfection of the land with the qualitative perfection of its leadership. Ultimately, a country's natural and acquired greatness depends entirely on the quality of the one who governs it.
